description.value: Triumph Coffee is an independent café in Vernon, BC, branding itself around 'outstanding coffee.' It offers online ordering through its website, suggesting a takeout-friendly model well suited to cyclists passing through the Okanagan. Its location on 30 Avenue puts it within reach of the Vernon town centre and surrounding cycling routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content retrieved is almost entirely GDPR/cookie consent banner text, yielding very little substantive business information. The page title 'Outstanding Coffee | Triumph Coffee' and the presence of an 'Order Online' subpage (/s/order) confirm the business is an active café offering online ordering (i.e., takeout). OSM tags supply internet_access=wlan, but per rules this cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation, so Wi-Fi is marked null.
concerns: Website content was almost entirely cookie/GDPR consent banner text; no substantive page content (menu, amenities, contact details) was extractable, so most amenity fields remain null.
OSM address omits the city name (Vernon); the postcode V1T 2E3 is consistent with Vernon, BC.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Triumph Coffee is a real, active café in Vernon with a functioning website and online ordering; it is publicly accessible and useful to touring cyclists.
